name: Fluidra
legalEntityNote: Fluidra, S.A. is the listed group parent. Its pool brands, regional subsidiaries, distributors and the entities named on product declarations can have different responsibilities for a customer, market or SKU.
headline: Fluidra ownership, pool-brand portfolio and channel responsibility
description: A source-backed profile of Fluidra's listed-group structure, AstralPool, Zodiac, Jandy and Polaris brand portfolio, pool-equipment operations and buyer checks.

ownership.summary: Fluidra, S.A. is a publicly listed pool and wellness group. Its corporate communications identify a portfolio that includes AstralPool, Zodiac, Jandy, Polaris, Gre, Cepex and CTXPro. Each mark should be distinguished from the group parent and the local seller or responsible entity for a particular product.

leadership.name: Eloi Planes
leadership.context: Fluidra's corporate materials identify Eloi Planes as Executive Chairman; current management roles should be checked against the latest annual report for transaction use.

productPortfolio.name: Pool circulation, filtration and water treatment
productPortfolio.positioning: Core residential and commercial pool equipment across Fluidra brand and regional portfolios.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Specify the approved brand, voltage, hydraulic specification and local technical support at quotation stage.

productPortfolio.name: Pool automation and connected systems
productPortfolio.positioning: Controls, monitoring and energy-management products under brands including Jandy and Zodiac.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm local app availability, installer support and compatibility with the existing pool pad.

productPortfolio.name: Polaris and other pool cleaners
productPortfolio.positioning: Cleaning equipment spanning robotic, pressure-side and adjacent pool-maintenance formats.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match the cleaner type, pool system requirements and local parts/warranty route.

productPortfolio.name: Commercial pool and wellness solutions
productPortfolio.positioning: Project-led equipment and service solutions for larger pools and wellness facilities.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Validate engineering responsibility, tender scope and commissioning support by country.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Fluidra reports a global pool and wellness operation with manufacturing sites, sales branches and brands across multiple markets.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not turn a group footprint into a universal origin claim for a SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Fluidra says it manufactures and/or distributes components used for residential and commercial pools.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm whether the exact product is manufactured, distributed or serviced by the local Fluidra entity.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Brand portfolio descriptions identify commercial families but not one factory or importer for every product.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Collect the declaration, label and shipment records for the contracted model.

marketsChannels.evidence: Fluidra reports sales branches and a network of group brands across more than 47 countries.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the local legal entity and distributor before committing to a channel program.

marketsChannels.evidence: The group supports residential, commercial pool and wellness buyers through brand-specific offerings.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify whether the relevant line is available to consumer retail, trade distribution or a project channel.

marketsChannels.evidence: Regional brand availability varies across AstralPool, Zodiac, Jandy, Polaris and other marks.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Check country catalogue, warranty and service documentation rather than relying on global branding.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Fluidra's advantage is breadth: components, controls, cleaners and professional project access can sit under one listed group. That breadth increases the need for buyer discipline. Brand familiarity does not answer who is contracting, manufacturing, importing, installing or honouring warranty for a specific pool system.
